description: Upcoming and past fixtures for a team or league, with provider-calendar date windows of up to seven days and paged games. No dates uses the provider default slate, or the current season for an ESPN team (MLB teams: 14 days back to 30 ahead). NCAAB covers men’s Division I; NCAAF scoreboards cover FBS. Returns opponents, UTC start, venue, and available results.

date_from.description: Inclusive provider-calendar start date, YYYY-MM-DD. A single bound requests that day.

date_to.description: Inclusive provider-calendar end date, YYYY-MM-DD. Retain this original end when continuing.

league.description: League identifier. Supported: nfl, nba, mlb, nhl, epl, mls, laliga, bundesliga, seriea, ligue1, ucl, ncaaf, ncaab.

limit.description: Games per page, default 100. Requests above 200 are clamped to 200 with disclosure.

offset.description: Game offset in the served window, default 0. Use nextOffset with the original date bounds.

team_name.description: Exact full name or abbreviation takes precedence; partial names or locations must identify one team. Omit for league-wide schedule.

name: sports_get_schedule

availableGames.description: Games available in the acquired window after filtering, never a total for unserved dates.

dateFrom.description: Start date filter applied, if any.

dateTo.description: End date filter applied, if any.

effectiveLimit.description: Applied game page size, at most 200.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `ambiguous_team`: The team selector matches more than one canonical team. `team_not_found`: The team_name resolves to no matching team in the league. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

games.description: Games in the requested date range.

items.description: A single scheduled or completed game.

score.description: Final score, null if game not played yet.

clock.description: Game clock display, null if not applicable.

score.description: Final score, null if game not played yet.

id.description: Source-prefixed game ID. Pass with this league to sports_get_game.

period.description: Current period or inning, null if not started.

source.description: Data source that provided this game record.

startTimeUtc.description: Game start time in UTC ISO 8601.

venue.description: Venue name, or null if unavailable.

nextDateFrom.description: Next provider-day window start, offered only after the final game page; retain requestedDateTo.

nextOffset.description: Next game offset; repeat the original bounds before advancing the date window.

offset.description: Applied game offset in the acquired window.

requestedDateFrom.description: Original inclusive start of the dated request.

requestedDateTo.description: Original inclusive end of the dated request; retain when advancing date_from.

scope.description: Acquisition scope when dates are absent or bounded.

servedDateFrom.description: First provider day acquired in this call.

servedDateTo.description: Last provider day acquired in this call, at most seven days after the first inclusive.

teamFilter.description: Team name filter applied, if any.

truncated.description: Whether game rows or requested dates remain unserved.

title: Sports Get Schedule
